To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) the proposed evaluation methodology for RL algorithms on distributions of RL environments is more effective than the standard evaluation methodology, which evaluates algorithms on a single RL environment; (2) the proposed evaluation method for offline learning of RL algorithms is more effective than standard evaluation methodologies for online learning of RL algorithms; and (3) the proposed evaluation methods can be used to evaluate RL algorithms on distributions and offline.
1. We propose a framework for evaluating reinforcement-learning algorithms on distributions of RL environments.
